registration.heading: Welcome to {server}
registration.intro: Enter this code to finish creating your account.
registration.footer: Someone used this address to sign up on {host}. If that wasn't you, ignore this email. No account will be created.

verification.heading: Verify your email address
verification.intro: Enter this code to add this address to your {server} account.

password_reset.preheader: Choose a new password for your account.

password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your {server} account. Choose a new one with the link below.
